inlines.v: RANGER, noun 1. One that ranges; a rover; a robber. [Now little used.] 2. A dog that beats the ground. 3. In England, a sworn officer of a forest, appointed by the king's letters patent, whose business is to walk through the forest, watch the deer, present trespasses, etc.
